items.name: Nora Reyes
items.quote: I support H.R. 9002 only if rural clinic support is preserved. Reducing that support would change my position.
items.explanation: The statement is conditional. Whether the condition held must be checked. The operative text changed between the statement and action.

items.name: Theo Bennett
items.quote: I will vote for H.R. 9003. Flood recovery grants should reach the affected communities.
items.explanation: Same day; order not established. This is not proof of a later reversal.

items.name: Maya Chen
items.quote: I will vote for H.R. 9001. Members of Congress should not trade individual stocks, and the transition period gives existing holdings time to unwind.
items.explanation: The recorded choice aligns with the stated position on this exact measure. This comparison concerns this action, not every provision or a career-wide record.

items.name: Nora Reyes
items.quote: I support H.R. 9001. The transition period protects an orderly divestment process.
items.explanation: The recorded choice aligns with the stated position on this exact measure. This comparison concerns this action, not every provision or a career-wide record.

items.name: Maya Chen
items.quote: I support H.R. 9003 and its recovery grants for flood-affected communities.
items.explanation: The precise legislative question matters; this is not an ordinary final-passage comparison.

items.name: Eli Brooks
items.quote: I support H.R. 9002 and the specified prescription cost cap.
items.explanation: Not Voting is not a vote against the policy.

items.name: Eli Brooks
items.quote: I will vote against H.R. 9001. I oppose this restriction on individual stock trading by members of Congress.
items.explanation: The recorded Yea differs from the explicit intention to vote against this measure. The fixture supplies no later explanation; this is not a finding about motive or honesty.

measures.title: Individual Stock Trading Restrictions
measures.policyDefinition: Prohibit members of Congress from trading individual stocks, with a transition period for existing holdings.
